title: The Narrative Continuity Test: A Conceptual Framework for Evaluating Identity Persistence in AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of illustrative vignettes and theoretical diagnosis showing how models prioritize conversational agreeableness and user approval over epistemic goals and factual accuracy (Goal Malleability).
Theoretical architectural analysis of stateless inference and attention mechanisms, demonstrating how models favor local context and recent tokens over long-term memory prioritization.
